verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents itself as a self-hosted platform built to run entirely offline, with air-gapped support. Its docs and GitHub README list Docker, Kubernetes, pip/uv and bare-metal installs, and community users confirm they run it themselves via Docker. missing for 10: evidence pack does not state what the changed license permits for self-hosted deployments, and community reports very large Docker images even when only API gateway use is needed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline
Open WebUI runs anywhere (Docker, Kubernetes, pip, bare metal)
Install seamlessly via pip, uv, Docker, or Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, or helm)
Air-Gapped: Complete network isolation for environments with the strictest security requirements.
